figures.caption: Figure 1. HYPE daily close on the Hyperliquid perpetual, December 2024 to November 2026, on a logarithmic price axis. Each shaded band runs from the peak to the trough of a decline of 25% or more and is labelled with its depth. Peaks and troughs are intraday prices, so the marked high and low sit beyond the line of closes.

Figure 2. HYPE hourly close over the last 90 days of the study, with the swing-level zones of the table below. Zones above the last close are resistance and zones below it are support. The two deepest support zones, below $48, are in the table only.
